About Eastminsters

Eastminsters is a USA-focused employment platform designed to connect job seekers with employment opportunities across different industries. We provide a simple way for candidates to explore career opportunities in transportation, cleaning, agriculture, freelancing, real estate, healthcare, construction, technology, customer service and more.

Trust & Safety

Important: Never pay an individual to guarantee you a job, interview, visa, placement or employment offer. Verify the employer and vacancy independently before sending sensitive documents or money.

Eastminsters contact: eastminstersusa@gmail.com

Telegram: @eastminstersUSA

Applicants should share only information necessary for a legitimate application and should be cautious with bank details, passwords, identity documents and payment requests.

Privacy & Terms

Before launch, add dedicated Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, Cookie/Tracking disclosure where applicable, and a clear statement explaining whether Eastminsters is a recruiter, job board, employment agency, or another type of service.
